We can make comparisons with the structure not as… as. We use it to make comparisons between two different elements using adjectives.

When we use the expression not as… as, we say that the two elements we are referring to are not equal. Plus, we say that the first element in the comparison is less than the second one.

Check the following structure:

Element 1 + verb ‘to be' + not as + adjective (+ complement) + as + element 2 (+ complement).

For example:
The logical schema is not as easy to understand as the physical schema.
Mary is not as confused as Gabriel regarding the independence in DBMS.
In fact, satisfying the users' requirements is not as tough as it may seem.
This is useful when there is not as much storage capacity as required, so we decide to upgrade it without affecting the overall core system's schema.
Review of Simple Tenses: Negative Form
We use the present simple and past simple to express different ideas or events in different times.
The logical data independence does not change the data that is contained on the disk, but it changes the information we store on the database's table formats.
I told him that when we referred to the logical data independence mechanism, we didn't refer to the way data was stored in the inside of the database, but to the way it was managed.

Present Simple

Remember that we use the present simple tense to talk about habits or facts. In this case, we will review its negative form. In order to write negative statements using this tense, we follow the structure:

Subject + do/does + not + verb in base form + complement.

For example:
The company does not satisfy the requirements of the user.
They do not understand what data independence is.

Remember that we can also use the verb ‘to be' in the present simple tense.

For example:
She is not ready to work for this company.
They are not at the meeting.

Past Simple

We use the past simple to refer to events or actions that started and finished in the past. In other words, they are no longer happening. In order to write negative sentences using the past simple, we follow the structure:

Subject + did + not + verb in base form + complement.

For example:
The company did not satisfy the requirements of the user.
They did not understand what data independence is.

Remember that we can also use the verb ‘to be' in the past simple tense.

For example:
She was not ready to work for this company.
They were not at the meeting.

images.text: <div align="justify">Data independence is a very important aspect related to DBMS or Database Management System, as it is key to manage and edit the information we can find in a database. Now, it is important to clarify that databases should follow a multi-layered architecture, which enables programmers to easily make changes in specific layers of the database systems without affecting the information contained in the rest of it.  In fact, with data independence making and keeping these databases updated is not as hard as many people think as they can actually use metadata which, in simple words, is the data we can obtain out of preexisting data to retrieve and locate information efficiently. In fact, satisfying the users' requirements is not as tough as it may seem.  </br>

<div align="justify">A colleague of mine didn't know anything about data independence that is why I told him that he had to check two different mechanisms: logical data and physical data independence. I told him that when we referred to the logical data independence mechanism, we didn't refer to the way data was stored in the inside of the database, but to the way it was managed. The logical data independence does not change the data that is contained on the disk, but it changes the information we store on the database's table formats. </br>

<div align="justify">On the other hand, we have the physical data independence, which is not as confusing as the previous mechanism. With this one, we can change the physical data of the database without affecting its logical data or schema of the system. This is useful when there is not as much storage capacity as required, so we decide to upgrade it without affecting the overall core system's schema.</br>
